title: Payment methods
name: Name
noOrdersForPayment: No orders for this payment method.
feeHintCod: Flat amount in DZD added to the order.
apiKeyHint: Hidden on display. Never paste a production key in a ticket.
inactiveHint: An inactive method no longer appears at checkout.
originDb: {n} method(s) read from the database — `doc_payments` document, shared by every workstation.
originDbEmpty: The database holds the `doc_payments` document and it is empty: someone saved it empty, and that is now everyone’s list. Start again from the shipped values, or restore this workstation’s local copy.
originNever: Never saved to the database: what you see here is this browser’s default list, shared with nobody. One save puts it in the database.
originNa: The database did not answer (silent API or missing `payments:read` right): the workstation shows its local cache.
defaultsSaved: Shipped values reloaded and sent to the database
backupEmpty: No usable local copy on this workstation.
typesAreCode: The list of types (transfer, CIB, card, PayPal, cheque, cash on delivery) is fixed by the code, not by the database: each type drives a behaviour — IBAN for a transfer, e-mail for PayPal, flat fees for delivery. A new method is created here, on any of these types.
apiKeyLocal: This key stays on THIS workstation: it is never sent to the database nor shared with other administrators — a gateway key in MySQL ends up in every database backup. A second workstation re-enters it, or better: the key lives in the server environment.
